title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
description:
S1 E1
Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

title: House Party
description:
S1 E1
When party time comes, it's time to tear the house down! If they get caught, it's all over. But if they don't, it's just the beginning! Kid 'N Play stars in the uproarious comedy that launched the House Party craze.

title: House Party 2
description:
S1 E1
High school is over, but the party is not. Join Kid n' Play for a hip-hop college adventure in House Party 2. Kid decides to pursue college, but when Play loses Kid's tuition money, the two boys have to devise a new plan -the wildest one yet!

title: House Party 3
description:
S1 E1
Prepare yourself for the ultimate house party: Kid gets engaged...and Play plans the bachelor party in House Party 3.

title: Brown Sugar
description:
S1 E1
Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
description:
S1 E1
Stella's vacation to Jamaica takes a hot and steamy turn when she encounters a young islander.

title: American Fiction
description:
S1 E1
Fed up with the establishment profiting from Black entertainment that relies on offensive tropes, a frustrated novelist decides to write an outlandish Black book of his own, one that propels him to the heart of the hypocrisy he disdains.
